tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Calm, cool off-white; never pure white for full pages.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, menus, inputs.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Relief tint: quiet panels, selected rows, table stripes. Never behind body text smaller than 14px in dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers, input borders at rest.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised and mist.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, metadata on surface, surface-raised and mist.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Bliss Navy, the trust colour. Brand fills, hero bands, the app icon. Identical in both themes so the brand stays recognisable.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and the reversed logo on a navy fill.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Bliss Mint, money in motion. Primary action fill, the lower half of the mark, progress, 'sent'. As a fill only; for mint text use mint-text.

tokens.name: on-mint
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a mint fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: mint-text
tokens.usage: Mint as text or icon: positive amounts, success copy, on surface, surface-raised or mint-soft.

tokens.name: mint-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind mint-text (success badges, received rows).

tokens.name: pending
tokens.usage: Pending/processing state as text or icon, on surface or pending-soft.

tokens.name: pending-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind pending text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, failed payments, destructive actions, as text or icon on surface or danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind danger text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring (2px, offset 2px). Navy in light, mint in dark — both 3:1+ against every surface.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links — an alias of mint-text.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Campaign and hero headlines. One per page.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Balances and the amount being sent. Always with tabular figures.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Arrives in seconds. Fee shown before you send.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Regulated in every market we operate

styles.name: reference
styles.usage: Transaction IDs, IBANs, account numbers — anything a person may read back to support.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; the 'speed cut' unit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inline gaps between controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; default gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; section gaps in a card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero and campaign spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, small inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the app icon at 64px (15).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and status dots; echoes the rounded ends of the mark.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Raised cards. Soft and low; Bliss never floats things dramatically.
